page.title: XML Export Structure
page.description: Discover how to seamlessly integrate the PropertyList infrastructure with your own digital ecosystem. This technical guide explains how to efficiently export your shared property data to external platforms and private websites.
page.body:
XML Export Structure: Integrating Your Digital Real Estate

To fully leverage the power of your property portfolio, PropertyList provides advanced technical capabilities to sync your digital real estate.
While we offer a customisable WordPress Plugin for an effortless setup, developers and technical teams can utilise our raw XML Export Structure to build highly tailored custom integrations.

Our XML export structure allows seamless integration with many Multiple Listing Services (MLS) and private websites, ensuring your property data is accurately and efficiently shared across platforms.


Comprehensive Data Formatting

When you deploy the XML export, you maintain total control over your shared inventory. The export formats include all essential property details required to market a home effectively, such as:
  • Detailed listing information and specifications
  • High-resolution images
  • Accurate pricing structures

Comprehensive property descriptions

(Note: To activate the XML Website Export functionality, agencies can deploy their Pay-As-You-Go credits for a flexible 35 Credits per month or a discounted 250 Credits per year allocation.)

Technical Requirements & Support Guidelines (Important)

Please note: Adding this XML export structure to your own website or custom software may require advanced technical knowledge. Because every agency's private website is built differently, PropertyList is unable to provide direct coding assistance or technical support for custom website integration.

If your development team requires additional details, specific structural requirements, or encounters issues with the data feed, please open a support ticket via your dashboard. Our team is here to assist you with any further platform information you may need to ensure a smooth data connection.
